title: LAA exclusion and ligation
scope: Schematic device designs on a representative appendage, not to scale. The appendage is drawn larger than in the source model so the device can be seen. Designs represent groups of devices rather than any product. The narrowed appendage base is a representative shape, not measured. No size, closure, fit or safety claim is made.
stageLabel: Schematic, not to scale. Representative appendage.
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

sources.title: Toronto Heart Atlas
sources.locator: RegularHeart chamber and vessel meshes, CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: NHLBI: How blood flows through the heart
sources.locator: Written heart-valve and circulation sections; no media reused.

designs.label: Exterior clip
designs.summary: A frame that closes across the base of the appendage from outside the heart.

designs.label: Suture ligature
designs.summary: A loop tightened around the base of the appendage from outside the heart.

states.label: 1. Before closure
states.note: Unnarrowed appendage, enlarged relative to the source model; source-derived context and a representative local ostium section.

states.label: 2. Clip open / loop loose
states.note: The clip bars are separated or the loop is loose around the same unpinched tissue. These poses do not simulate delivery.

states.label: 3. Clip closed / loop tightened
states.note: The device and tissue are both in representative narrowed poses; closure and deformation are not calculated.

states.label: Contact emphasis
states.note: Marks where the closed device meets the representative narrowed tissue, not a computed contact or seal.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Where the device sits on the heart
views.lesson: These devices stay outside the heart, on the base of the appendage. Nothing enters the left atrium.

views.label: From outside
views.title: How the device closes the base
views.lesson: Compare the same camera before closure, with separated bars or a loose loop, and with the representative narrowed base.

views.label: From the atrium
views.title: Compare an open entrance with a narrowed throat
views.lesson: A separate representative local ostial section shows a patent entrance before closure and a narrowed throat afterward. It replaces the source cast only in this view; no pulmonary-vein openings are represented.

clipheart.label: CLIP ON THE BASE
clipheart.body: The clip is placed on the outside of the heart, at the base of the appendage.

bars.label: PARALLEL BARS
bars.body: Two bars press toward each other across the base of the appendage from outside.

base.label: NARROWED BASE
base.body: The base flattens where the bars press on it. This shape is representative, not computed.

sac.label: EXCLUDED APPENDAGE
sac.body: The appendage beyond the device stays in place, separated from the atrium in this illustration.

loopheart.label: LOOP ON THE BASE
loopheart.body: The loop is placed from outside the heart, around the base of the appendage.

loop.label: TIGHTENED LOOP
loop.body: A loop is tightened around the base, drawing the tissue inward from all sides.

knot.label: KNOT
knot.body: The tightened loop is secured in place. The knot shape is representative.

sac2.label: EXCLUDED APPENDAGE
sac2.body: The appendage beyond the loop stays in place, separated from the atrium in this illustration.

closedopening.label: NARROWED OPENING
closedopening.body: This separate representative tissue section ends in a narrow slit or pucker. The throat remains open in the mesh; this does not claim complete anatomical closure.

openbars.label: SEPARATED BARS
openbars.body: The two bars are separated around the unpinched base. The hinge and delivery sequence are omitted.

looseloop.label: LOOSE LOOP
looseloop.body: The loop is shown loose around the unpinched base, before the narrowed pose. Its route is representative.
